title: Flixora - AI Movie Recommendation & Streaming Platform
description: A state-of-the-art hybrid entertainment platform that unifies Subscription Video on Demand (SVOD) streaming with physical cinema hall ticket reservations, delivering a seamless experience for digital streaming and real-world movie experiences.
architecture: Built with a hybrid full-stack architecture using Next.js, React, Express.js, MongoDB, Better Auth, Stripe, and Google OAuth. The platform uses MongoDB atomic operations for real-time seat locking and automatic expiration, while flexible aggregation pipelines unify booking records across guest and authenticated users. Stripe powers both recurring streaming subscriptions and cinema ticket purchases, with digital QR-coded PDF entry passes generated after successful reservations.
features: Hybrid SVOD streaming and physical cinema ticket reservation system
10-minute atomic MongoDB seat-locking mechanism to prevent double-booking
Automatic seat-lock expiration and reservation lifecycle management
Unified ticket resolution across guest checkout and authenticated user collections
User ID and email-based booking aggregation with duplicate prevention
Stripe Checkout integration for streaming subscriptions and cinema ticket purchases
Digital QR-coded PDF cinema entry pass generation
Google OAuth authentication with Better Auth
Movie discovery, filtering, watch history, and personalized recommendations
Subscription-based streaming access with multiple membership plans

challenges.title: Real-Time Seat Reservation & Race Conditions
challenges.challenge: Preventing double-booking when multiple users select the same cinema seat simultaneously.
challenges.solution: Implemented a 10-minute atomic seat-locking mechanism in MongoDB with automatic expiration timers to temporarily reserve seats and prevent concurrent bookings.

challenges.title: Unified Ticket Resolution Across Collections
challenges.challenge: User booking data was fragmented across guest checkouts and separate database collections.
challenges.solution: Engineered a flexible API aggregation pipeline that matches records using userId and userEmail, deduplicates booking data, and serves unified digital ticket passes.

challenges.title: Hybrid Architecture: SVOD + Cinema Booking
challenges.challenge: Combining recurring video subscriptions with one-time physical cinema ticket purchases within a single platform.
challenges.solution: Built a dual Stripe checkout architecture that handles streaming subscriptions and cinema ticket payments while generating digital QR-coded PDF entry passes.

futureEnhancements.title: Real-Time WebSocket Seat Syncing
futureEnhancements.description: Upgrade seat availability synchronization from HTTP polling to WebSockets using Socket.IO for instant, sub-second seat updates across all connected users.

futureEnhancements.title: Mobile App & Offline Downloads
futureEnhancements.description: Build a Progressive Web App (PWA) or React Native application supporting offline video downloads for on-the-go streaming.

futureEnhancements.title: Local Payment Gateway Integrations
futureEnhancements.description: Expand payment options beyond Stripe by integrating popular local payment gateways such as bKash, Nagad, and SSLCommerz alongside Apple Pay and Google Pay.

title: RecipeHub - Recipe Sharing Platform
description: A production-grade full-stack recipe sharing platform where users can discover, create, like, and manage recipes, while administrators monitor content, user permissions, and platform analytics through a secure dashboard.
architecture: Designed with Next.js App Router and React Server Components for optimal LCP performance. The backend utilizes Express.js microservices with MongoDB schema indexing for fast aggregation pipelines. Authentication is secured via JWT and Firebase Auth, while Stripe handles premium subscription webhooks.
features: Role-based RBAC authentication for Users and Administrators
Create, edit, delete, and manage personal recipe repositories
Full-text fuzzy search engine with category filter pipeline
Like, favorite, and report inappropriate recipe submissions
Stripe payment gateway integration with dynamic checkout session
Responsive User Dashboard with real-time status updates
Admin Analytics Dashboard for user management and reporting
Secure JWT authentication with protected middleware routes

title: Job Portal Web Engine
description: A high-concurrency full-stack job portal platform connecting job seekers with recruiters, featuring real-time application tracking, automated job filtering, and recruiter dashboards.
architecture: Built with modular MERN stack architecture. Express.js REST APIs process job postings and application submissions, while MongoDB indexes ensure sub-50ms search query responses. Styled with high-contrast obsidian Tailwind glassmorphism.
features: Dual recruiter and applicant authorization profiles
Post, edit, and archive dynamic job listings
Advanced search with location, salary range, and tech stack filters
One-click application workflow with resume attachment tracking
Recruiter analytics dashboard monitoring application pipelines
State-persistent session storage with JWT validation

title: Programming Courses Platform
description: A modern, responsive e-learning platform providing structured programming courses, interactive code snippets, module tracking, and seamless course exploration.
architecture: Engineered for maximum frontend responsiveness using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. Employs lightweight client component state trees and pre-rendered SSG layouts for immediate page transitions.
features: Comprehensive course catalog with topic categorization
Detailed course curriculum breakdown and instructor profiles
Mobile-optimized responsive learning UI with dark theme
Instant client-side filter and course search bar

title: Doctor Appointment Manager
description: A medical scheduling system enabling patients to find specialist doctors, select available time slots, book online consultations, and manage digital medical appointments.
architecture: Constructed with Node.js and Express REST services interfacing with MongoDB Atlas database collections. Features custom date-time availability collision detection algorithm to prevent double-booking.
features: Doctor specialty directory with availability schedule view
Interactive appointment calendar booking system
Patient booking management and status updates
Secure user login and profile authorization
